scope: production kline_daily_enriched coverage and VCP research baseline

cause: The partial-partition guard treated any enriched/raw row-count difference as corruption although legitimate halt placeholders are filtered from enriched data.
An interior raw-only date was not classified as a full rebuild, so a later affected-symbol update could recreate it with only the small symbol subset.

behavior: Compare enriched symbols with raw symbols after the shared halt filter.
Classify every missing date inside the existing enriched range as requiring a full rebuild.
